titulo: Boss of STIHL: Time for reforms – this is how we will safe prosperity and welfare state
cuerpo: The German economy has been in crisis for years. Writes Nikolas Stihl in an OpEd für Euronews. Better business conditions are the key to breaking out of this stagnation. What’s at stake is nothing less than securing prosperity and welfare state. STIHL is the world’s best-selling chainsaw brand.
